[Unit]
Description=Dell NAS Jellyfin (requires verified data filesystem)
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service network-online.target srv-dev\x2ddisk\x2dby\x2duuid\x2d5b19837c\x2d128c\x2d498a\x2db79d\x2d563db810c34a.mount
Wants=network-online.target
RequiresMountsFor=/srv/dev-disk-by-uuid-5b19837c-128c-498a-b79d-563db810c34a
BindsTo=srv-dev\x2ddisk\x2dby\x2duuid\x2d5b19837c\x2d128c\x2d498a\x2db79d\x2d563db810c34a.mount
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/dell/nas
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/libexec/dell-nas-check-data --mountpoint /srv/dev-disk-by-uuid-5b19837c-128c-498a-b79d-563db810c34a --uuid 5b19837c-128c-498a-b79d-563db810c34a
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose --env-file /opt/dell/nas/.env -f /opt/dell/nas/compose.yaml up --no-build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from jellyfin
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose --env-file /opt/dell/nas/.env -f /opt/dell/nas/compose.yaml stop --timeout 30
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStopSec=60

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
